core_conclusion: The complete water-bearing Marmousi-II truth and its 150 m Gaussian initial model share the same grid and water domain; their signed differences localize the geological detail removed by smoothing.
scientific_question: Which Vp and Vs structures are retained or removed by the declared initial-model smoothing?
layout: Vp and Vs rows; truth, initial, and initial-minus-truth columns

panel_roles.b: Vp initial-model control under the same absolute color scale
panel_roles.c: Signed Vp information removed or shifted by smoothing
panel_roles.d: Vs reference geological structure including zero-Vs water
panel_roles.e: Vs initial-model control under the same absolute color scale
panel_roles.f: Signed Vs information removed or shifted by smoothing

data_integrity.crop: None beyond the declared full ADFWI-paper crop
data_integrity.density: Constant 2450 kg/m^3 in truth and initial, including water

geometry.status: Declared full P-SV case geometry; figures describe model inputs, not a completed inversion

review_risks: Incorrect native-z reversal could invert the geology
The former solid-only SH crop must not be substituted
Independent absolute color scales could hide smoothing effects
A clipped difference scale could hide extreme residuals
Density and zero-Vs water must not imply a positive-Vs floor
Model input figures must not be described as inverted models
